_metadata.description: Portal Everywhere acceptance obligations for Bridge-mediated, Device Control-owned browser desktop sessions.

requirements.title: Native companion readiness
requirements.description: Given a Bridge-managed companion is installed on an authorized node, when readiness is probed, Device Control shall report the active user session, selected display, capture permission, input permission, clipboard capability, helper generation, and exact unavailable reason without inferring readiness from service presence.

validation.notes: Offline readiness, permission, no-Aqua, and missing-VP8-encoder refusal seams are tested; active approved macOS session receipt remains open.

requirements.title: WebRTC display session
requirements.description: Given a valid Device Control lease and Bridge channel grant, when Web Console opens one selected display, Device Control shall publish a VP8 WebRTC video track and expose connection state, selected display identity, frame dimensions, and bounded transport statistics.

validation.notes: Pion VP8 peer, browser signaling, SCTP data-lane input receipt, selected-display enforcement, and bounded statistics are focused-tested; browser/companion direct and TURN live evidence remains open.

requirements.title: Lease-bound raw input
requirements.description: Given an interactive session, when pointer, keyboard, wheel, or clipboard commands arrive, Device Control shall require the current lease epoch and destination, reject stale commands, release held input on stop or loss, and return accepted, rejected, or outcome-unknown receipts without blind replay.

validation.notes: Lease/epoch, takeover, stale command, data-lane input receipt, peer-failure cleanup, and release semantics are focused-tested; live native input and crash receipts remain open.

requirements.title: Text clipboard capability
requirements.description: Given clipboard scope is explicitly granted, when the operator requests text transfer in either direction, Device Control shall enforce size and encoding limits, audit the transfer, and refuse clipboard activity after expiry or revocation.

validation.notes: Bounded text and scope/refusal semantics are implemented and tested; live Unicode transfer receipt remains open.

requirements.title: Session revocation and recovery
requirements.description: Given a desktop peer is active, when Bridge revokes the node or Device Control expires/kills the lease, the peer shall close, queued input shall be rejected, held input shall be released, and reconnect shall require a new session and epoch.

validation.notes: Session close, revoke, stale epoch, and reconnect generation semantics are tested; paired live target receipt remains open.
